[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
David Glasgow was born on 22 June 1798 and baptised on 10 July 1798 in Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland. Two Findmypast OPR transcripts give his parents as Thomas (Thos) Glasgow, a plowman, and Mary Chapman, with residence at Clifton.<ref name="FMPbirth">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4478206&tab=this David Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4478206] (reviewed 23 October 2026), birth 22 June 1798, Kirknewton and East Calder; Thos Glasgow and Mary Chapman, residence Clifton; citing OPR 690/3, item 2, p. 45. Original register image uninspected.</ref><ref name="FMPbaptism">Same collection, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4477035&tab=this David Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4477035] (reviewed 23 October 2026), birth 22 June and baptism 10 July 1798; Thos Glasgow, plowman, and Mary Chapman, residence Clifton; citing OPR 690/3, item 2, p. 15. Original register image uninspected.</ref> The existing family account links [[Glasgow-1620|Thomas Glasgow]] as father and [[Chapman-28491|Margaret Chapman]] as mother. Companion indexes name her “Mary or Margaret Chapman”; the OPR transcripts say Mary. Her identification with the attached Margaret remains unresolved, so this draft makes no parent-link change.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686208988&tab=this Findmypast companion baptism index R_686208988] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691906855&tab=this companion index R_691906855], David Glasgow, baptised 10 July 1798, mother indexed “Mary Or Margaret Chapman”; inspected provider transcripts, original image uninspected.</ref> The baptism locality and Clifton residence do not separately prove David's exact birthplace.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1620]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The OPR transcripts distinguish David's 22 June 1798 birth from his 10 July baptism and identify Thos Glasgow as father at Clifton; the baptism transcript calls him a plowman.<ref name="FMPbirth" /><ref name="FMPbaptism" /> The same transcripts call the mother Mary Chapman, while companion indexes say Mary or Margaret and the attached mother is [[Chapman-28491|Margaret Chapman]]. Her identity remains a separate question, with no parent change proposed here.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.

Next useful test: Inspect both OPR images for maternal wording and test whether Mary and the attached Margaret Chapman are one woman.
